zona_eszak_kutya.title: North, the zone of Water
p: On the traditional Chinese direction map, the Kan trigram belongs to the North, and the image of Kan is Water. Its world of meaning holds depth, flow, adaptation, and hidden things, and also the possibility of danger, so it is not simply a symbol of calm or rest. Tradition associates the northern direction with a more restrained, inward-turning character.

If your dog rests in the northern part of your home, it is worth looking at the spot through this image. Not because the northern part is sure to be cool or dark, since only the real home can show that, but because Kan raises good questions.

draft.dog: If there is a noticeable draft near the resting place, it is worth checking whether it is constant and whether the resting place itself is in a direct air current. For dogs, a bed exposed to a direct draft can be especially unpleasant. A draft is not automatically a problem in itself: it is worth observing how strong and persistent it is, where it occurs, and how your dog reacts to it.
draft.cat: If there is a noticeable draft near the resting place, it is worth checking whether it is constant and whether the resting place itself is in a direct air current. For cats, proper thermal comfort is important, especially when a cat spends longer periods resting in one place. A draft is not automatically a problem in itself: it is worth observing how strong and persistent it is, where it occurs, and how your cat reacts to it.

empty: This reading still needs a little more information. Tell us roughly which part of your home your pet rests in, or answer “Yes” to at least one question about the resting place. The question about drafts does not count toward this, but for the question about a protected backdrop, a “No” answer also counts. The answers you have already given will be kept.
